subject: Media Literacy
title: The AIDA Formula
description: A 60-second lesson on The AIDA Formula.

hook.text: Every ad you've ever responded to followed the same invisible formula from 1898.

buildup.text: AIDA stands for Attention, Interest, Desire, Action — the four stages of any persuasive message.

discovery.text: First grab attention, then build interest, then create desire, then prompt action. Every ad follows this path.

twist.text: Social media compressed AIDA into seconds. Swipe, scroll, click, buy — all before you even think.

climax.text: Once you see the AIDA structure, you'll recognize it in every ad, email, and landing page.

punchline.text: Attention. Interest. Desire. Action. Now you see the strings.

quiz.question: What does AIDA stand for in advertising?
